title: Concrete Bassline v2
description: A 140 BPM UK dance-pop cut built on a hard 909 four-on-the-floor and a gritty sub-sine bassline that walks through a minor progression. This version answers the note for more interest by adding a syncopated rap-ready snare/rim pocket, a call-and-response square-synth riff, a vowel-filtered stab, ghost-note hat ratchets, and a half-time breakdown so the arrangement keeps shifting rather than repeating.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.05),
    s("~ rim ~ rim").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(220).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("~ hh ~ hh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).cut(1),
    s("~ rim ~ [rim rim]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.42),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<260 340 420 520>/2").gain(0.6).shape(0.2)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5),
    s("~ ~ ~ [~ sd]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.42),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 2>")),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<420 600>/2").gain(0.6).shape(0.25),
    note("<[eb3,g3] ~ [g3,bb3] ~>*2").s("square").lpf(1400).gain(0.4).attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).pan(0.65)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5),
    s("~ ~ ~ [sd sd]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<[c1 c1 g0 c1] [eb1 eb1 c1 g0] [g0 g0 bb0 c1] [f0 f0 g0 ab0]>*2").s("sine").lpf("<700 520>/2").gain(0.6).shape(0.3),
    note("<[eb3,g3] ~ [g3,bb3] [f3,ab3]>*2").s("square").lpf(1700).gain(0.42).attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).pan(0.65),
    note("<g4 ~ bb4 ~ ~ ab4 ~ g4>").s("square").lpf(2200).gain(0.34).attack(0.005).decay(0.1).sustain(0).delay(".3:.1875:.4").pan(0.35)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>/2").s("sine").lpf("<340 460>/2").gain(0.62).shape(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>/2").s("square").lpf(900).gain(0.38).attack(0.02).decay(0.4).sustain(0.2).release(0.3).vowel("<a e o>"),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).room(0.3),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).cut(1).degradeBy(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.15),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.52),
    s("~ ~ ~ [sd sd sd]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.42),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.52).cut(1).degradeBy(0.12).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<[c1 c1 g0 c1] [eb1 eb1 c1 g0] [g0 g0 bb0 c1] [f0 f0 g0 ab0]>*2").s("sine").lpf("<820 640 1000 720>/2").gain(0.6).shape(0.32),
    note("<[eb3,g3] ~ [g3,bb3] [f3,ab3]>*2").s("square").lpf("<1800 2400>/2").gain(0.44).attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)),
    note("<g4 bb4 ~ ab4 g4 ~ f4 g4>").s("square").lpf(2600).gain(0.36).attack(0.005).decay(0.1).sustain(0).delay(".3:.1875:.45").pan(0.32).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.05),
    s("~ rim ~ rim").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<420 260>/2").gain(0.6)
  )]
)
